connector.name: MCP Server by YokuApp
connector.registryDescription: Yoku is a platform that provides structured, real-time brand identity and company data.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.yoku.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the yokuapp account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
